Official Jersey Jack Harry Potter 1.26 changelog

strategy.summary: Shoot the center and staircase ramps until all eight Hogwarts banners are down, then shoot the staircase ramp to start Explore Hogwarts Multiball. Collect four different Jackpots to light the roving Super Jackpot; if Multiball ends first, the Super remains lit.

quickInfo.name: Explore qualification
quickInfo.summary: The first start spots both green and both yellow banners. Shoot the center or right ramp when its lit color matches an unspotted banner; two matching shots can finish the remaining four banners.

quickInfo.name: Explore Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: Each collected Jackpot shot goes dark; four different Jackpots light a roving Super Jackpot, while extras raise its value.

quickInfo.name: Explore recovery
quickInfo.summary: An uncollected Super Jackpot remains lit after Explore Hogwarts Multiball ends.

quickInfo.name: Hagrid add-a-ball
quickInfo.summary: After two Explore Jackpots, the green Hagrid target lights for add-a-ball.

quickInfo.name: Terms and lessons
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the right Time-Turner spinner until Start Term lights, then shoot the scoop and select a school year. Lessons advance when completed or timed out, and ten lessons qualify a Final Exam.

quickInfo.name: First Horcrux requirements
quickInfo.summary: Complete Flourish & Blotts for the Diary, collect an Explore Hogwarts Super Jackpot for the Ring, start Death Eater Multiball for Nagini, collect a Golden Trio Super Jackpot for the Cup, collect ten Allies for the Locket, collect a Quidditch Super Jackpot for the Diadem, and complete The Deathly Hallows for Harry.

quickInfo.name: Keep Horcruxes after The Boy Who Lived
quickInfo.summary: Complete the harder second requirement for each Horcrux: earn two Flourish & Blotts spells; collect two Explore Supers; collect the Death Eater Frenzy Jackpot; collect a full-value Golden Trio Super with all three balls on the wands; finish one Ally mode's stated shot goal; loop three Quidditch Supers; or make six story advances before completing The Deathly Hallows.

quickInfo.name: Death Eater Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the Death Eater drop target, then hit the figure twice within 20 seconds. Defeat two Death Eaters this way to start Multiball. All other game rules are disabled during it.

quickInfo.name: Quidditch Multiball retry
quickInfo.summary: If Quidditch Multiball ends before the Diadem Horcrux, catch one Snitch to relight the first retry, two after the second failure, and all three after the third.

steps.text: Shoot the center ramp and staircase ramp to lower the eight Hogwarts banners. Follow the banner colors shown on the display.
modeNotes: Explore Hogwarts qualification: The first start begins with both green and both yellow banners spotted. A correctly colored center-ramp and staircase-ramp shot can finish the remaining red and blue banners in as few as two shots.

steps.text: Shoot the staircase ramp when all eight banners are down to start Explore Hogwarts Multiball.
During Explore Hogwarts, shoot four different lit jackpots. Hit the green Hagrid target after two jackpots when add-a-ball is lit.
modeNotes: Explore Hogwarts Multiball: Each jackpot shot goes dark after collection. Four jackpots light a roving Super Jackpot. Extra jackpots increase its value.

steps.text: Track the roving Super Jackpot and take it on a comfortable shot. If multiball ends first, control the ball and collect the still-lit Super Jackpot in single-ball play.
modeNotes: The first Explore Hogwarts Super Jackpot also collects the Ring Horcrux. An uncollected Super Jackpot remains lit after multiball.

steps.text: Between Multiballs, shoot the right Time-Turner spinner until Start Term lights, then shoot the scoop and select a school year with the flippers and action button. Shoot the red-and-gold lesson shots; the right spinner adds time.

fallback.title: School Terms and Final Exam
fallback.when: Use school Terms to advance the six-year lesson path.

steps.text: Shoot the right Time-Turner spinner until Start Term lights, then shoot the scoop and select a school year with the flippers and action button.
Shoot the red-and-gold lesson shots. Completing or timing out a lesson advances the Term; shoot the right spinner to add time.
After ten lessons, shoot the scoop when Final Exam is lit. Complete its six lesson requirements to light O.W.L.s Multiball at the center lane.
Shoot the center and staircase ramps until all eight Hogwarts banners are down.
Start Explore Hogwarts Multiball at the staircase ramp.
Collect the roving Super Jackpot and Ring Horcrux.

strategy.simpleOverview: Harry Potter starts school Terms at the scoop after Time-Turner progress, while lowering all eight colored banners qualifies the first Explore Hogwarts Multiball. Shoot the right spinner until Start Term lights, then use the scoop and select a school year with the flippers and action button. Shoot the center and staircase ramps to lower the banners; after the last falls, shoot the staircase ramp again to start Multiball.
strategy.overview: Harry Potter tracks six school years of lessons and five Multiballs. For an opening Explore Hogwarts Multiball, shoot the center and staircase ramps to lower all eight colored banners, then shoot the staircase ramp again. Collect four different Jackpots to light the roving Super Jackpot, and hit Hagrid after the second Jackpot for add-a-ball. Between Multiballs, shoot the right Time-Turner spinner until Start Term lights, shoot the scoop, and complete the red-and-gold lesson shots; ten completed lessons qualify Final Exam at the scoop.
